messages.subject: define margins/size
parts:
Hej
so far I define the size of the plot when saving it using: ggsave(name, file="image.jpg", width=5, height=5, dpi=400)

but how can I set the margins already in the plot? I have to different plots I want to put next to each other, they contain different content,
but I want them at least from the plot area match in size.

How can I do that?

Thanks
Inga

messages.author: 14bf9d058b4385ae
messages.subject: RE: define margins/size
parts: I’m not exactly sure what you are asking, but I have found the viewport() feature to be useful for creating multiple-panel plots.  The panels seem to line up better when pushed to a viewport than when the panels are manually lined up from individual .jpg images.
